# Default applications

Everything here comes from the shipped settings, so it cannot drift out of step
with what the desktop actually does. Change any of it in the settings app, or
in `~/.config/hypr/settings.lua`.

## Programs

| Role | Program |
|---|---|
| Terminal | `kitty` |
| Browser | `brave-origin` |
| File manager | `nemo` |
| Editor | `code` |
| Launcher | `rofi -show drun` |
| Calendar | `gnome-calendar` |
| Mail | `evolution` |
| Images | `loupe` |
| Music | `flatpak run com.spotify.Client` |

## How to reach them

| Keys | Opens |
|---|---|
| `SUPER + Return` | Terminal |
| `SUPER + B` | Browser |
| `SUPER + E` | File manager |
| `SUPER + Space` | Application launcher |
| `SUPER + R` | Application launcher |
| `SUPER + SHIFT + C` | Editor |

## Changing them

Settings → Defaults, or edit `programs` in `~/.config/hypr/settings.lua`.
The key bindings refer to roles (`@browser`), never to a program name,
so switching your browser is one edit in one place.
